title: Branch Wars
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'Branch Wars,' tensions rise as Stanley considers leaving for Utica, prompting Michael to intervene and attempt to persuade him to stay. Meanwhile, Jim resists a prank trip to Utica, and the office characters engage in various schemes, including a copier mishap and a prank plan. Andy faces rejection from The Finer Things Club, and the episode concludes with characters dealing with personal and professional conflicts, including Jim's relationship with Pam and Jim's interactions with Karen.
